summary: The candidate fixes deterministic prefilled-Qwen3 parsing in the gRPC response path, but it does not touch the HTTP connection-mode router selected by the original reproduction's http:// worker URL. Its tests manually initialize the upgraded parser rather than exercising gateway routing/response processing. It also initializes reasoning from a thinking toggle without requiring think_in_prefill, which misclassifies a tag-free response as reasoning in an independent boundary test.

tests.what_was_measured: The original http://worker URL selects ConnectionMode::Http; the HTTP router forwards responses and has no reasoning-parser call. All candidate functional changes are confined to routers/grpc/.

gpu_execution.evidence: The verified failures are deterministic CPU-side Rust routing/parser behavior. The assigned gfx950 GPU was not used; Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 weights and the reporter's NVIDIA L40S environment were unavailable.

native_rebuild_evidence: The exact candidate Rust sources and reasoning-parser v1.3.0 were compiled with rustc 1.90.0 into /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-0a083c28e3ad/target-candidate/debug/deps/ and the resulting smg library test binary ran. Cargo resolution evidence is in candidate-cargo-tree.log and artifact hashes in candidate-artifacts.sha256.
remaining_counterexamples: The original reproduction uses --worker-urls http://worker:8000, selecting ConnectionMode::Http. The candidate changes only the gRPC router, so reasoning_content remains whatever the worker returned (null when worker-side parsing is disabled).

When thinking is enabled but the tokenizer reports think_in_prefill=false, candidate initialization still marks the parser as already reasoning. A tag-free response such as 'plain answer' is then moved wholly into reasoning_content instead of content.
remaining_limitations: No Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 weights were available, so no full-model HTTP or gRPC serving reproduction was run.
The prepared architecture is AMD gfx950 with ROCm 7.2, not the reporter's NVIDIA L40S CUDA environment.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture was not used because it cannot qualify Qwen3.8 chat-template behavior and the decisive HTTP routing gap is source-level.
No GPU execution was performed; model inference quality and model-specific emitted token sequences remain unverified.
